Environment My

environment is very nice and I like it very much. Environment means every thing around us My

like trees plants animals birds rivers sky and people. We all live in the environment and if it

become dirty then it is not good for anyone: teacher tell us that we should always keep our My

environment clean because it help us to live happy and healthy:

In my house there are many plants. My mother put water to them every morning and sometime I

also help her: like the green leaves because they look fresh and pretty: We also have small

flowers they smell very good. When butterfly come on the flowers I feel happy and like to watch??

them for long time:

Near my school there is a park: Many children come there to play football cricket and big

running: There are many big trees in the park. When I sit under the tree it is cool and nice??

because the tree give us shade: Many birds sit on the branches and make sweet sound: like

hearing them because it make me smile:

One day was walking with my father and we saw many plastic bottles on the road. It was

looking very dirty. We pick up some of the bottles and put them in the dustbin: was feeling

proud because helped to clean the place. My father said even if one person do small things it

can make a big difference.

Sometimes people throw garbage on the road and in the river. This is not good because animals

can get hurt and the water become dirty: Fish and other water animals need clean water to live.

If we cut too many trees then birds and animals will not have homes. This make me sad

because Fiove animals very much.

At my school we celebrated Environment We planted small trees and our teacher told us Day:

not to waste water and electricity: We also made posters with crayons. poster said save My

trees save earth: was very happy because my friends liked my poster even if it was not the

best onc.

always to switch off the lights when nobody is in the room: 1 also close the tap after washing try

my hands. tell my little brother not to throw wrappers on the ground. Sometimes he forget but

then I remind him again: We both want our place to be clean and beautiful:

think every person should love the environment because it give us air water food and many

other things. If we take care of nature then nature will take care of us. love my environment

very much and I want it to stay clean green and happy forever:
